events.title: Adult Leisure Swim
events.description: Adult leisure swim is an unstructured swim for those looking to exercise, socialize or relax in the water. This swim is open to persons 16 years of age and older.  Lap swimming within the therapy pools may not be permitted based on attendance and size of pool to ensure the safety of patrons. Please check with the lifeguard staff on site if permitted during your swim.

events.title: Lane Swim
events.description: Lane swim is a structured swim for continuous 25m lap swimming.  Pools are divided to allow for a circular pattern while swimming.  Lane division will be based on the pace of the swimmers.  Swimmers need to be comfortable in deep water and are required to swim continuously within the lane.   Swimmers may be required to complete a swim test.  Admission standards apply.

events.title: Drop In Cardio and Tone
events.description: This workout consists of options for high and low impact cardio moves, followed by a toning segment which may include the use of resistance equipment.

events.title: Drop In Ai Chi
events.description: Ai Chi is a gentle group exercise program in warm, chest-deep water. It is based on a series of 19 flowing movement patterns similar to Tai Chi. The class begins with breathing exercises and progresses by adding upper body movements, trunk stability challenges and lower body movements. It is designed to increase range of motion and over all mobility while promoting relaxation and a healthy mind-body relationship. Excellent program for those with Fibromyalgia.

events.title: Drop In Pilates
events.description: A full body conditioning class that focuses on abdominal/core stability while providing a mind-body workout. Emphasis is placed on the breath, body alignment, control and form to aid in improved posture and mobility.

events.title: Drop In Hip & Knee
events.description: Hip and Knee provides participants with exercises specifically designed for those with hip / knee joint degeneration and injuries or who are preparing or recovering from hip or knee surgery. The low impact class will focus on range of motion for the joints, muscle conditioning, balance and postural training. This class is held in a warm water pool.

events.title: Fun Skate
events.description:
Enjoy a fun and active recreational skating experience for skaters of all ages and abilities! Participants are required to pay admission and wear a wristband while on the ice.

To help create a safe and enjoyable environment for everyone, figure skating skills (e.g., jumps, spins, and footwork) are not permitted.
Equipment and Safety:
For added safety, the use of a CSA-approved hockey helmet is strongly recommended. Participants may use approved skating aids.
City staff will be available to support a safe and positive skating experience and may conduct periodic checks to ensure participants are following program guidelines:


https://www.mississauga.ca/recreation-and-sports/sports-and-activities/skating-and-hockey/


For the safety and enjoyment of all participants:

• Please follow the guidance of Skate Patrol and program staff to help keep the ice safe and enjoyable for all participants.
• We ask all participants to be respectful of others and follow program guidelines so everyone can have a positive experience.
• Programs are recreational and non-contact, providing a fun environment for leisure skating. Hockey games, scrimmages, sticks, pucks, equipment, and other toys are not permitted on the ice.
• Please enjoy food and beverages in designated areas off the ice surface.
• Approved skating aids permitted
• Please skate in the designated direction as directed by staff.
• For everyone's safety, children must remain on their own skates and may not be carried on the ice.
To ensure fair access and enjoyment for all participants, private or commercial instruction is not permitted during City-run public skating programs or arena ice times in City of Mississauga recreation facilities.
We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to welcoming you to the ice!

events.description: This is an un-organized, pay as you go badminton drop-in that is open to youth and adults. Space is limited. This drop-in will be run at a first come first serve basis.

events.title: Therapeutic Time
events.description: Therapeutic time is dedicated pool time to do your prescribed exercises for rehabilitation/post rehabilitation in an unstructured swim in the therapeutic pool. This swim does not have an instructor, specialized therapeutic equipment is only available during this time. Verified Health Care Providers must identify themselves to Customer Service staff upon entry.

events.title: Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Basketball
events.description: FREE youth basketball drop-in. This unstructured basketball program is open to youth. Space is limited and participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Check your local Community Centre for the schedule.

events.title: Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Chill Zone
events.description: FREE youth drop in chill zone. This unstructured program is available to youth to play games, finish homework and hangout with friends. Space is limited and participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Check your local Community Centre for the schedule.

events.title: Drop In Oh My Aching Body For Women
events.description: This program is designed for women/girl participants with a woman instructor. The pool area and viewing areas will be restricted to women/girls only (except in an emergency). Men/ boys have access to common areas hallways and office areas. Oh My Aching Body is recommended for those with arthritis, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis and Parkinson's disease and would benefit from exercise in warm water. Exercises selected work all the joints and muscles of the body in a safe and enjoyable environment. This class is held in the warm water therapeutic pool.

events.title: Drop In Total Body Workout
events.description: Full body workout using various cardio formats and strength training exercises.

Men/ boys have access to common areas hallways and office areas.   Aquafitness is a low impact workout using the resistance of the water for a great workout.
